narrative.summary: The same Governor → Timelock → Safe shape as the factory above, but for per-vault risk parameters, with a real 2-day delay, genuinely not instant despite the "Emergency" name.
narrative.tag: cross-exposure: 80 (pushed on-chain 2026-09-20), same DAO Safe as the factory
narrative.detail: Not confirmed this pass: which, if any, of the 156 deployed vaults actually point their own governor() at this specific address (a vault’s creator chooses at deploy time). Scored on the mechanism’s own confirmed-live strength, not on unconfirmed reach. Pushed on-chain 2026-09-20: the DAO Safe that proposes on this governor’s timelock is the same 4-of-8 Safe as the factory’s, whose 8 signers are identical to Euler’s DAO Safe on Monad, so crossExposureScore is folded to a flat 80 (admin, multisig and timelock unchanged).
